name: Unidirectional propagation qualifier
summary: This qualifier indicates a signal or propagation path with one documented direction.
description: This qualifier indicates a signal or propagation path with one documented direction. The flow is an information or signal relationship, rather than necessarily a conductive power path. A sending element and receiving element can each need separate auxiliary supplies.
Label the signal and interface at each end. Keep supply conductors and signal-direction annotations visually distinct when both appear in the same diagram.
readingNotes: Identify the source, destination and signal type in the surrounding diagram.
Signal direction must not be confused with the direction of power flow.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Identify the source, destination and signal type in the surrounding diagram.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: Signal direction must not be confused with the direction of power flow.
